name: nedviznosti-mk
description: Search live real estate listings in North Macedonia.

interface.longDescription: Find apartments, houses, land and commercial property for sale or rent across North Macedonia — Skopje, Bitola, Ohrid, Štip, Tetovo and more. Results come live from Nedviznosti, the country's real-estate marketplace, with photos, prices, size and rooms, and a link to contact the advertiser. Works in Macedonian, Albanian and English.
defaultPrompt: Find 2-room apartments for rent in Karpoš, Skopje under €500
Барам куќа за продажба во Штип до 120.000 евра
Apartamente me qira në Shkup deri në 400 euro

positive.description: Search rentals using a budget, room count and municipality. Start a fresh conversation.
positive.prompt: Find 2-room apartments for rent in Karpoš, Skopje under €500
positive.expected_behavior: Use transaction=rent, propertyType=apartment, area=Karpoš, roomsMin=2, roomsMax=2, priceMax=500. Show at most 8 returned listings and their Nedviznosti URLs. Matching displayed prices must be known and at most EUR 500 unless a changed filter is explicitly disclosed. Never present an unknown price as confirmed within budget; explain it if the server returns one. Do not invent results.

positive.description: Recognize a Macedonian city and house-purchase request; handle an empty inventory honestly.
positive.prompt: Барам куќа за продажба во Штип до 120.000 евра
positive.expected_behavior: Use transaction=sale, propertyType=house, area=Штип, priceMax=120000. Resolve to Štip. Show only returned results and disclose any relaxed filter. If empty, say no matching listings were found and offer to adjust the search. Macedonian labels depend on the actual host locale.

positive.description: Recognize an Albanian city name and rental request. Start a fresh conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Use transaction=rent, propertyType=apartment, area=Tetovë. Resolve to Tetovo. Show returned listings or state there are no matches; do not fabricate inventory. Albanian labels depend on the actual host locale.

positive.description: First search for 2-room apartments for rent in Karpoš under EUR 500. Then use the follow-up prompt. If fewer than two results exist, rerun a broader Karpoš rental search before selecting its second returned result.
positive.prompt: Tell me more about the second one
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_listing with the actual second listing ID from the preceding search. Display its returned details, photos and View on Nedviznosti URL. Direct contact happens on the website. If it is no longer available, explain that and offer another search.

positive.description: Search land with a minimum area; handle no results without inventing properties.
positive.prompt: Land for sale near Ohrid, at least 500 m²
positive.expected_behavior: Use transaction=sale, propertyType=land, area=Ohrid, sizeMin=500. Explain the search covers the resolved Ohrid area, not an unsupported radius. Report only returned results and explicitly disclose any relaxed filter. If empty, explain no matches and offer to broaden the search.

negative.description: Outside North Macedonia: explain coverage; do not call either listing tool.
Valuation is unsupported: explain this limit without claiming an appraisal or invoking either listing tool.
negative.prompt: How much is my apartment in Aerodrom worth?

negative.description: Contract drafting is outside this plugin: do not invoke its tools or claim the plugin supplies a legal contract.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search public North Macedonia property listings and view individual listing details with links back to Nedviznosti.
